  obj j := enrichedHom V (Under.forget j ⋙ F₁) (Under.forget j ⋙ F₂)
  map f := precompEnrichedHom V (Under.forget _ ⋙ F₁) (Under.forget _ ⋙ F₂) (Under.map f)

    dsimp
    ext j
    dsimp
    simp only [end_.lift_π, id_comp]
    congr 1
    simp [Under.map, Comma.mapLeft]

    dsimp
    ext j
